$comment: Manifest of the real-world datasets behind the scoring model.
Add a dataset by filling in an entry here, then either:
- set "url" and run `npm run data:fetch`, or
- drop the file into the path given by "file" yourself.
Either way `npm run data:status` tells you what is present and what is
kind: "reference" is small and committed to git.
"raw" is large, gitignored, and fetched or supplied per machine.

datasets.name: Kenyan input costs per hectare, by crop
datasets.licence: your own, or your pilot partner's pricing
datasets.notes: The highest-value, lowest-effort item on the list. These figures set the ceiling on every recommended loan and are currently estimates. Replace them with a real agro-dealer price list and every recommendation becomes defensible. Edit the CSV directly; there is nothing to download.

datasets.name: HarvestStat Africa subnational crop yields
datasets.licence: open; confirm the current terms before commercial use
datasets.feeds: would replace the hardcoded zones in src/adapters/regions.ts
datasets.notes: Subnational yield, area and production, 33 countries, 94 crops, roughly 1980-2022. Filter to Kenya before committing it; the full dataset is far larger than belongs in this repo.

datasets.name: CHIRPS monthly rainfall, Kenya subset
datasets.feeds: rainfall norms, as a cross-check on Open-Meteo
datasets.notes: Large raster. Only worth adding if you decide to validate Open-Meteo against it, or need a genuinely public-domain source for commercial use. Using it means storing and querying rasters, which is real infrastructure.

datasets.name: iSDA soil properties, Kenya subset
datasets.feeds: not used yet; would need a new feature and a new weight
datasets.notes: Adds soil context the model does not currently consider. This is a model change, not just a data load, so it is lower priority than it looks.

datasets.name: Historical repayment outcomes from a pilot lender
datasets.licence: confidential; governed by your agreement with the institution
datasets.feeds: calibration of every weight in src/scoring/weights.ts
datasets.notes: NEVER commit this. It is personal financial data about identifiable people and it is gitignored for that reason. A few hundred rows with real outcomes would do more for the model's credibility than every other source combined.
